fullDescription: AETHER AI is a high-end, futuristic design system emphasizing 'Cyber-Luxury' and 'Creative Intelligence.' It features a dark-mode aesthetic (#050505) characterized by glassmorphism, neon accents (Cyan #00f2ff, Purple #bc13fe), and atmospheric parallax effects. The style is defined by its wide, editorial typography using Syncopate and Space Grotesk, coupled with subtle textures like SVG noise and geometric grid lines. It is ideal for high-tech SaaS, AI research labs, futuristic branding agencies, and premium fintech products that require a sense of precision and sophisticated scale.
prompt:
## Resumo
A high-contrast, dark-mode design system with a futuristic 'cyber-luxury' feel. It utilizes deep blacks, neon blue/purple gradients, glassmorphism cards, and sophisticated scroll-triggered animations (GSAP) to create an immersive, cinematic web experience.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design with a deep black background (#050505). Overlay a subtle SVG noise texture (baseFrequency: 0.65, 5% opacity) and a geometric grid (40px spacing, #ffffff08). Typography: Use 'Syncopate' (Bold, Tracking: -0.05em) for hero headlines and 'Space Grotesk' (Weights: 300, 400, 600) for body and UI elements. Colors: Cyan (#00f2ff), Neon Purple (#bc13fe), and Emerald (#39ff14). Use glassmorphism for containers (Background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03), backdrop-filter: blur(10px), border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)). Animation style: Smooth scroll-triggered reveals using cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) and parallax image scaling (scale 1.12 to 1.0).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation
A fixed, transparent top navigation bar. On scroll, it transitions to a dark background (#050505) with a backdrop blur. It includes a logo with a 45-degree rotated square icon and uppercase, widely spaced navigation links (Tracking: 0.2em, Size: 12px).

### Hero Section
A full-height (100vh) section featuring a parallax background image (45% opacity) with a gradient overlay (Black to Transparent). Headline: Massive Syncopate text (Size: 9xl) with a gradient clip-text effect (Cyan-White-Purple). Include a small, pulsing pill badge above the title for 'Live' status or taglines.

### Service Grid
A three-column grid of glass-effect cards. Each card has a large icon, bold Syncopate titles, and a hover effect that includes a slight Y-axis translation (-5px) and a border color change to the respective accent color.

### Content Split Section
A 50/50 split layout. Left: A square image with a grayscale filter (50% opacity) and a technical 'CORE_XX' label in the corner. Right: Modern editorial text with large stats (4xl font size) and a high-contrast 'Meet' button.

### Testimonials
A two-column grid featuring high-contrast testimonial cards. Each card has a 2px left-border in a neon accent color (Cyan or Purple) and uses italicized 'Space Grotesk' for quotes, creating a professional yet futuristic testimonial style.

### Typographic CTA & Footer
A centered final section with extremely large headline (Size: 8xl) using 'Syncopate'. Below it, a large blocky button with heavy tracking (0.3em). The footer is minimal, featuring a top border (1px solid #ffffff05) and social icons in a row, with a scrolling parallax text marquee hidden in the background.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Neon Conic Button — A button with a hidden rotating border animation.
Define a button with position:relative and overflow:hidden. Use a ::after pseudo-element with a conic-gradient (transparent to #00f2ff) that rotates 360 degrees indefinitely. The gradient should only be visible (opacity: 1) on hover, creating a 'tracing' neon light effect around the button border.

### Hero Line Reveal — Typography reveal animation for main headlines.
Wrap each line of text in a container with overflow:hidden. Animate the inner span from translateY(100%) to 0% using an 'expo.out' easing function for a dramatic, cinematic entrance.

## Notas Especiais
Must maintain the noise texture and grid lines at all times to prevent the UI from looking 'flat.' Typography must always be uppercase for buttons and headers to maintain the architectural feel. Do not use rounded corners larger than 8px (except for small pill-badges). Ensure every glass-card has a subtle border to define its edges against the dark background.

style.description: The style essence is 'Futuristic Precision.' It pairs a technical sans-serif (Space Grotesk) with a bold, wide display font (Syncopate). The color palette is strictly dark (#050505) with vibrant neon highlights. Visual depth is achieved through an SVG noise overlay, a 40px geometric grid, and blurred radial blobs in the background. Components use glassmorphism with backdrop filters and thin, 1px borders.
